source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Collect necessary information.
3. Document the incident thoroughly.
4. Record the details: date, time, and location of the accident.
5. Describe what happened, in detail, including the sequence of events.
6. Identify witnesses and record their statements.
7. Take photographs or videos of the scene, if possible.
8. Record the injuries and immediate medical treatment provided.
9. Report the incident to the relevant authorities or supervisors.
10. File an official report with your organization's safety department.
11. Keep copies of all documentation.
12. Ensure confidentiality and accuracy in all records.
13. Organize and maintain records for review and potential investigation.
14. Follow up to document any changes in the injured employee's status.
15. Review prevention measures to ensure similar incidents do not recur. 

When documenting reportable workplace accidents, accuracy is key. Make sure to record all details precisely, including the immediate actions taken post-accident and any related follow
